LiteRT's C API headers, as the shim beside this directory includes them.

From https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT at tag v2.2.0 (commit
145c7523ff08d5e57ab5c582141775eea47da9c7), the release of the binaries jetlink
opens: the ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 wheel's libLiteRt.dylib on a Mac, and the
com.google.ai.edge.litert:litert:2.2.0 AAR's libLiteRt.so on Android.

Only the headers the shim needs and the ones they include, unmodified, except
litert/build_common/build_config.h, which LiteRT's build generates: it is a
copy of litert/build_common/config/build_config_gpu_npu.h, Bazel's default.
